t: A free library of research-based K-12 AI curricula from MIT RAISE.
steps: Find the MIT RAISE Curricula Library on the MIT RAISE site.
Browse the listing and note the grade range of each unit.
Open the unit that fits your class, such as AI and Ethics.
Read that unit's own setup steps.
Check which tools and devices the unit needs.
Check the license for the unit before copying or sharing it.
Pilot one lesson with a small group first.
